mapper.insert: INSERT INTO users (id, username, password_hash, role, display_name, is_active, tenant_id, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{username}, #{passwordHash}, #{role}, #{displayName}, #{isActive}, #{tenantId}, datetime('now'), datetime('now'))
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT * FROM users WHERE username = #{username} AND deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT * FROM users WHERE deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT * FROM users WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY created_at DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE users SET password_hash = #{passwordHash}, role = #{role}, display_name = #{displayName}, is_active = #{isActive}, tenant_id = #{tenantId}, updated_at = datetime('now') WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE users SET password_hash = #{passwordHash}, updated_at = datetime('now') WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE users SET deleted_at = datetime('now') WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users WHERE username = #{username} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE users SET last_login_at = datetime('now') WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE users SET balance = balance + #{amount}, updated_at = datetime('now') WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE users SET balance = balance - #{amount}, updated_at = datetime('now') WHERE id = #{id} AND balance >= #{amount}
